rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is done in an impractical or unrealistic way.

example.english: They planned the whole wedding unfeasibly, leaving no time for breaks.
example.traditional: 佢哋唔切實際噉安排成個婚禮，連休息時間都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 m4 cit3 sat6 zai3 gam2 on1 paai4 seng4 go3 fan1 lai5 lin4 jau1 sik1 si4 gaan1 dou1 mou5

rows.note: Use this when “unfeasibly” stresses that the action or degree is effectively impossible rather than merely impractical.

example.english: You’re trying to finish an unfeasibly large amount of work in one day.
example.traditional: 你冇可能噉喺一日內做完咁多嘢。
example.jyutping: nei5 mou5 ho2 nang4 gam2 hai2 jat1 jat6 noi6 zou6 jyun4 gam3 do1 je5
